subject: Look for the Coeliac UK Accreditation

media.alt_text: Graphic tip card explaining Coeliac UK gluten-free restaurant accreditation

caption.body:
One thing worth knowing about in the UK: Coeliac UK accreditation. It means the restaurant has verified GF preparation processes, staff trained on celiac specifically, and regular audits.

It's not just a sticker — there are actual requirements behind it. In Scotland, I found accredited spots including Browns in Glasgow (5/5 on my GF scale).

If you're eating somewhere new and want a quick shortcut to feeling safer, it's always worth asking: "Are you Coeliac UK accredited?"
